Data Sources.description: Reference. Where each input came from and its status. Not joined to the facts.

Resort Weeks.description: Fact. One row per resort per season week (10 resorts x 36 weeks = 360 rows). Snow conditions, weather, crowding, prices and the precomputed suitability scores for that resort in that week.

Resorts.description: Dimension. One row per ski resort (10): location, elevation, terrain size, lift count, slope mix, snowmaking and airport access.

Score Weights.description: Reference. The weight and interpretation of each component in the suitability scores. Not joined to the facts.

Season Weeks.description: Dimension. One row per week of the season calendar (36 weeks): season, week start date, week number in the season, month, season phase and holiday flag.

Country.description: Country the resort is in (France, Switzerland, Austria, Italy, Germany).

Crowd Level.description: Crowd Index banded, numbered so it sorts from quiet to packed: 1 Quiet (under 55), 2 Steady (55-64), 3 Busy (65-79), 4 Packed (80+).

Gateway Airport.description: The airport guests fly into for this resort: the natural market for flight-based marketing.

Month.description: Calendar month of the week's start date. Sorts in time order, unlike the Month text field.

Resort.description: The ski resort (10 resorts, all fictional).

Season.description: Ski season, December to March: 2024/25 or 2025/26.

Season Axis.description: NOT USED by the season measures; kept for ad-hoc analysis over MCP. A period-comparison measure on this axis is refused by the engine (error 013401, 'period-comparison calendar selection has no unambiguous time axis') whenever a query also filters a Season Weeks field (Season Stage, Week Type, Season Week), so the This/Last Season measures name the seasons explicitly. Anchored at 2026-04-05: with periodEnd 'latest' the comparison window dropped the last week of 2024/25.

Season Phase.description: Part of the season: Early season (weeks 1-3), Peak winter (4-8), Mid winter (9-13), Spring (14-18). Sorts alphabetically; order charts by First Season Week.

Season Stage.description: Part of the season, numbered so it sorts in time order: 1 Early season (weeks 1-3, early Dec), 2 Peak winter (4-8, Christmas to mid Jan), 3 Mid winter (9-13, late Jan to Feb), 4 Spring (14-18, March). Same split as the Season Phase field.

Season Week.description: Week number within the season, 1 (first week of December) to 18 (last week of March). Lines up the two seasons week by week.

Snowfall Band.description: Fresh snow in the 7 days of the week, banded in 20 cm steps. Labels sort in band order.

Week.description: Calendar week, by its Monday start date. One row per week.

Week Type.description: Holiday week (Christmas/New Year and the late-January/February school holiday week) or Regular week.

Avg Base Depth.description: Average snow base depth in cm. A snapshot per week: averaged, never summed. Up is good.

Avg Crowd Index.description: Average Crowd Index (0-100): the only demand signal in the data, used as the proxy for visits. There is no visitor count. Up is good for the operator.

Avg Expert Score.description: Average expert score (0-100): advanced terrain, vertical drop, snow depth. Weight 15%.

Avg Family Score.description: Average family score (0-100): beginner terrain, transfer time, lift access. Weight 10%.

Avg Lift Pass per Day.description: Average one-day lift pass price, in euros.

Avg Lodging 7 Nights.description: Average price of 7 nights' lodging, in euros.

Avg Open Terrain.description: Average share of the resort's terrain open in the week.

Avg Quiet Score.description: Average quiet score (0-100): lower crowd index. Weight 15%.

Avg Snow Score.description: Average snow score (0-100) from recent snowfall, base depth and open terrain. Weight 35% in the Overall Week Score.

Avg Trip Cost.description: Average cost of a ski week for one guest (6-day lift pass plus 7 nights lodging), in euros.

Avg Value Score.description: Average value score (0-100): lower weekly trip cost relative to the other resorts. Weight 25%.

Avg Weekly Snowfall.description: Average fresh snow per resort-week, in cm.

Base Depth Change vs Last Season.description: Average base depth, 2025/26 minus 2024/25, in cm. Up is good.

Base Depth This Season.description: Average base depth in season 2025/26 (a weekly snapshot, averaged).

Bluebird Days.description: Clear-sky days after snowfall, summed over the selected resort-weeks.

Crowd Index Change vs Last Season.description: Average Crowd Index, 2025/26 minus 2024/25, in index points. Up is good.

Demand Headroom.description: Avg Snow Score minus Avg Crowd Index, in index points: how much better the snow is than the demand it draws. A large gap marks resorts and weeks where conditions are good but crowds are thin, which is where extra marketing has most room. A modelling assumption: both are 0-100 indexes, not visits.

Demand Headroom Change vs Last Season.description: Demand Headroom, 2025/26 minus 2024/25. Down is good: crowds catching up with the snow.

First Season Week.description: Earliest season week in the selection. Orders Season Phase chronologically.

Holiday Crowd Uplift.description: Avg Crowd Index in holiday weeks minus regular weeks, in index points. Empty when the selection holds no holiday weeks or no regular weeks (the engine would otherwise count a missing side as 0).
Holiday Crowd Uplift.expression: IF({m1} IS NULL OR {m2} IS NULL, NULL, {m1} - {m2})

Holiday Crowd Uplift Change vs Last Seas.description: Holiday Crowd Uplift, 2025/26 minus 2024/25, in index points. Down is good: regular weeks catching up with holidays. Empty when either season has no holiday or no regular weeks in the selection.
Holiday Crowd Uplift Change vs Last Seas.expression: IF({m1} IS NULL OR {m2} IS NULL OR {m3} IS NULL OR {m4} IS NULL, NULL, {m1} - {m2} - {m3} + {m4})

Holiday Crowd Uplift This Season.description: Holiday Crowd Uplift in season 2025/26, in index points. Empty when the selection holds no holiday or no regular weeks.
Holiday Crowd Uplift This Season.expression: IF({m1} IS NULL OR {m2} IS NULL, NULL, {m1} - {m2})

Lowest Crowd Index.description: Lowest weekly Crowd Index in the selection. Also orders Crowd Level bands.

Overall Week Score.description: How good a week is for a guest (0-100): the weighted blend of the five scores using the weights in Score Weights (Snow 35%, Value 25%, Quiet 15%, Expert 15%, Family 10%).

Overall Week Score Change vs Last Season.description: Overall Week Score, 2025/26 minus 2024/25, in points. Up is good.

Peak Crowd Index.description: Highest weekly Crowd Index in the selection.

Quiet Powder Weeks.description: Resort-weeks with 40 cm or more of fresh snow but a Quiet crowd (index under 55), outside holidays: great conditions nobody came for. The marketing target list.

Quiet Powder Weeks Change vs Last Season.description: Quiet Powder Weeks, 2025/26 minus 2024/25. Down is good: fewer good weeks left empty.

Resort Weeks.description: Number of resort-weeks (one resort open for one week).

Share of Quiet Powder Weeks.description: This row's Quiet Powder Weeks as a share of all Quiet Powder Weeks in the current selection.

Snowfall Change vs Last Season.description: Growth in total fresh snow, 2025/26 against 2024/25. Up is good.

Snowfall This Season.description: Total fresh snow in season 2025/26 (the latest complete season). Season named explicitly: a Season Axis comparison is refused by the engine whenever a filter touches the Season Weeks view (stage, week type).

Suggested Budget.description: What-if: a marketing budget (parameter budget, default EUR 250,000) split in proportion to each row's share of Target Weeks in the selection. A planning rule, not a forecast: it puts money where good snow went unsold.

Suggested Budget at Default Rule.description: Baseline for the marketing what-if: the default plan, EUR 250,000 split by each row's share of regular resort-weeks with at least 40 cm fresh snow and Crowd Index below 55. No parameters, so it stays fixed while the levers move Suggested Budget.

Target Weeks.description: Campaign rule for the marketing what-if: regular (non-holiday) resort-weeks with at least minSnow cm of fresh snow (default 40) and a Crowd Index below maxCrowd (default 55). With the defaults it equals Quiet Powder Weeks.

Target Weeks Change vs Last Season.description: Target Weeks in 2025/26 minus 2024/25 under the same campaign rule (parameters minSnow, maxCrowd; defaults 40, 55). Written out in full rather than over the two season measures so the what-if parameters reach both sides.

Target Weeks Last Season.description: Target Weeks (the campaign rule) in season 2024/25 only. Same parameters and defaults (40, 55) as Target Weeks.

Target Weeks This Season.description: Target Weeks (the campaign rule: regular resort-weeks with at least minSnow cm fresh snow and Crowd Index below maxCrowd) in season 2025/26 only. Same parameters and defaults (40, 55) as Target Weeks.

Total Snowfall.description: Fresh snow summed over the selected resort-weeks, in cm. Up is good.

Trip Cost Change vs Last Season.description: Growth in average ski-week cost, 2025/26 against 2024/25.

Trip Cost This Season.description: Average ski-week cost per guest in season 2025/26.
